title: Kids With the Greatest Number of Candies
summary: Given an array of kids' candies and extra candies, determine if each kid can have the most candies after receiving all extra candies.
statement: Given an array of kids' candies and extra candies, determine if each kid can have the most candies after receiving all extra candies. Return a boolean array indicating whether each kid can achieve the maximum number of candies.
constraints: Give the same extra-candy amount hypothetically to each child in turn.
Return whether that child could then have at least as many as the current maximum.
hints: Find the largest current candy count once.
For each child, add the hypothetical extra amount.
A child qualifies when that sum is at least the maximum.
The children are independent because the extra candies are hypothetical, not consumed.
editorial: The children are independent because the extra candies are hypothetical, not consumed.

tests.explanation: After receiving three, every child except the one starting at one reaches at least five.
Only the child already holding four can reach the maximum four.
